subject: Intro call with Redwood — quick availability?

Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 30 Aug 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Intro call with Redwood — quick availability?

Hi Keisha,

Thanks for applying to the Product Operations role at Redwood Inference — I'm Connor on the recruiting team. I'd love to set up a quick 25-minute phone screen to learn about your background and share more about the team.

Do any of the following windows work for you next week (I included both PDT and the equivalent UTC times to avoid timezone confusion):
- Tue 9/1, 9:30–10:00 AM PDT (Tue 16:30–17:00 UTC)
- Tue 9/1, 4:00–4:30 PM PDT (Tue 23:00–23:30 UTC)
- Wed 9/2, 8:00–8:25 AM PDT (Wed 15:00–15:25 UTC)

If none of those work, send 2–3 windows that are convenient in your local time and I’ll convert them. I can also do an earlier/later slot if you’re outside North America — just let me know your timezone.

I’ll send a calendar invite once we lock a time. I attached a tentative 25-min slot in case it helps (redwood_initial-screen.ics) — you can ignore it until we confirm.

Best,
Connor O'Brien
Technical Recruiter | Redwood Inference
connor.obrien@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0183

- Tue 9/1 9:00–9:30 PM IST (which should line up with your Tue 9/1 8:30–9:00 AM PDT?)
- Wed 9/2 7:30–7:55 PM IST
- If you need an earlier US-morning slot while I'm traveling, I can do 2:00–2:25 AM BST on 9/4 (not ideal, but possible).

I attached my resume for reference. Let me know what works and I’ll accept the invite.

Thanks,
